At a distance, painted stags appear constructed in the general shape of male deer, their flanks and antlers decorated with unique, colorful patterns. But while they retain (and indeed, augment) the blueprints [Shumunue](/Deities.aspx?ID=275) imparted upon them, painted stags reject the confines of the Carved Lady's art of mimicry. Today, their cloven, hardwood hooves can crush bone and daub paint with equal skill, and their antlers snap together in a deadly vise. Their torsos rotate freely to navigate the latticed trees of their home plane—all the better to chase prey to their inevitable death. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 26 **[Recall Knowledge - Plant](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 26 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21 [Painted Stag](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2678) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 210 **Perception** +21 **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +18, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +23, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +18 **Str** +7 **Dex** +3 **Con** +5 **Int** +2 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +4 --- **AC** 27 **Fort** +18 **Ref** +12 **Will** +21 **HP** 175 , regeneration 10 (deactivated by [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) **Immunities** bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Weaknesses** [axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1) 10, fire 10 --- **Speed** 45 feet, climb 60 feet **Melee** antler +20, **Damage** 2d12+7 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Melee** hooves +20, **Damage** 2d10+7 bludgeoning **Mauler** A painted stag gains a +5 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20). **Painted Dance** ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The stag shakes the wooden plating along its body in a cacophonous clatter that sets its painted patterns dancing. All creatures within 60 feet of the painted stag who can see or hear it must attempt a DC 28 Will save; a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) by the stag takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its save. Regardless of the result of its save, each creature is temporarily immune for 1 hour.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) by the painted stag for 1 round.
**Failure** The creature is [stunned 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36) and fascinated by the painted stag for as long as it's stunned.
**Critical Failure** As failure, except stunned 4.
Artistic Exchange Though few know it, painted stags paint their own markings—making their sporadic appearances in elven art and tattoos, particularly in those cultures descended from the lost nation of Mierani in Varisia, all the more appropriate. Many modern depictions, however, erroneously portray them as benevolent protectors of the forest. Only Darklands tattoo cultures consistently depict them as the relentless predators they truly are.
